annotations.title: ERC-20 token USD price from on-chain DEX pools

description: Spot USD and native-coin price of an ERC-20 token on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, OP Mainnet, Polygon or Avalanche from its deepest Uniswap v2/v3 pool (plus Aerodrome on Base) paired with the wrapped native coin or USDC, with each pool's fee and USD liquidity, the best pool, a confidence level and the block read. Sources: on-chain reads via PublicNode JSON-RPC (official RPC fallback); native USD from Uniswap v3 pools. Price: $0.002 per successful call, paid in USDC with x402 v2; failed calls and calls that match nothing are not charged.

address.description: Token contract address (0x followed by 40 hex characters).

chain.description: Chain of the token: base (8453), ethereum (1), arbitrum (42161), optimism (10), polygon (137), avalanche (43114). Chain ids and aliases such as eth, arb, op, matic, avax are also accepted.
